title: A DANGER STANDS OVER THE DOWNED CARD
why: Follow-up to v36.75: the danger plate now stands at 27 percent of the height, and the downed card (lifted off the player in v35.xx) stands at the same height, so a danger said while you are down would draw on the card. While you are down the plate now stands on top of the card, clear of it.
now: A danger said while you are down stands over the downed card, never on it.

edits.replacement: var DOWNGAP=64, DOWNLIFT=0, DOWNTOP=0;   // v36.77 (cw-dangerdown): DOWNTOP is the top of the downed card on the screen, in px, as last drawn

edits.anchor: function alertSlotY(){ return Math.max(ALERTY||LH(96),Math.round(H*ALERTYF/((HUDZ.msg||1)*hudRes()*hudUserZ('msg')))); }   // the top of the danger plate, before the message scale
